## Silver Storm / Hired Gun — *Fallout Equestria: Heroes*

Silver Storm is the tough, deeply scarred earth-pony protagonist of *Fallout Equestria: Heroes*, a fanfiction by **No One**. Once a guard in Marefort, she tries to save her brother from the Crimson Hoof; the mission ends disastrously, and she later reinvents herself as the mercenary **Hired Gun**. These are two names for the same mare, not separate identities. She belongs to the *Heroes* story continuity, not the official *Friendship Is Magic* television continuity. [Original story](https://www.fimfiction.net/story/662/Fallout-Equestria:-Heroes).

**Recognize her:** A big, muscular silver-gray mare with pink-and-white mane, lavender eye, green cybernetic eye (often covered by an eyepatch), mechanical leg, PipBuck, and a three-rock cutie mark. The fan wiki also records **Star-Mare** as a codename. [Character reference](https://falloutequestria.fandom.com/wiki/Hired_Gun_(Heroes)).

**Names, appearances, and voice:** “Silver Storm” is her original name in the story; she personally chooses “Hired Gun” after her injury, rather than receiving a fan-assigned name. She narrates and speaks throughout the novel, first serialized in 2011 and completed in 2019. There is no verified G4 episode, film appearance, official speaking role, or official voice-actor credit for her.

## Important moments

- **A rescue mission becomes a tragedy — Prologue.** Silver Storm and Wildfire approach Stable 42 to confront the Crimson Hoof; Wildfire is fatally shot, shattering Silver's hopes of straightforward heroism. [Read the scene](https://www.fimfiction.net/story/662/1/fallout-equestria-heroes/prologue).
- **Becoming Hired Gun — Chapter 1, “Deja Vu.”** After doctors replace her poisoned leg, she explicitly gives her new name and decides to prioritize survival over heroics. [Read the scene](https://www.fimfiction.net/story/662/2/fallout-equestria-heroes/chapter-1-deja-vu).
- **Choosing Serenity — Chapter 3, “Bullets And Brainwaves.”** Although hired to deliver a captive filly to slavers, Hired Gun kills their leader and protects Serenity, beginning their family bond. [Read the scene](https://www.fimfiction.net/story/662/4/fallout-equestria-heroes/chapter-3-bullets-and-brainwaves).
- **Naming her family — Chapter 32, “Building Bridges.”** She introduces Serenity as her daughter and Platinum Haze as her marefriend, an important contrast to her hardened mercenary persona. [Read the scene](https://www.fimfiction.net/story/662/33/fallout-equestria-heroes/chapter-32-building-bridges).
- **The cost of being remembered — Epilogue, “Seven Years Later...”** Serenity's testimony makes clear that loving Silver Storm does not require forgiving every choice she made. [Read the epilogue](https://www.fimfiction.net/story/662/42/fallout-equestria-heroes/epilogue-seven-years-later).

*These are prose chapters, not animated episodes; episode-video timestamps are unavailable.*
